instruction: Apply italic formatting and blue font color to all slide text, covering both regular and table content.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting all text content (including table) and applying both italic formatting and blue font color. The custom getter extracts italic status and color of all text runs, and the metric verifies that all runs are both italic and blue. Verified that the original presentation has text in both regular shapes and table cells that need formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: all text must be italic AND blue (including table cells)
Getter logic properly iterates through all slides, shapes, and table cells to check every text run
Blue color detection uses flexible thresholds (rgb[2] > 150 and rgb[2] > rgb[0] + 50 and rgb[2] > rgb[1] + 50) that correctly handle LibreOffice standard blue RGB(0, 112, 192)
Metric correctly compares the boolean result (all_italic_and_blue) against expected value
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before verification to ensure fresh state
Edge cases handled: checks for RGB attribute existence and None values before color comparison
Correct parameter handling: metric accesses expected.get('all_italic_and_blue') directly since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding explicit logging/debugging info about which runs failed (if any) to help with troubleshooting, though this doesn't affect verification correctness
